entry.name: jit.unpack
entry.digest: Make multiple single plane matrices out of a multiplane matrix
entry.description: The jit.unpack object splits one N-plane matrix into N single-plane matrices. This is useful for splitting one ARGB matrix into separate alpha, red, green, and blue matrices, and similar types of splitting.

arguments.name: planecount
arguments.description: The number of planes in the input matrix and the number of single plane matrix outlets for theobject (default = 4).
